headword: {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}

definitions.gloss: once in a lifetime; a unique and unrepeatable occasion
definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens only once in one's entire life, or an opportunity so rare that it should be treated with great importance.

examples.japanese: {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧だった。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦したくない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A wedding is a once-in-a-lifetime event, so I don't want to have regrets.

examples.japanese: {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{逃|のが}す→逃す：04611_nogasu⟧わけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't afford to let a once-in-a-lifetime chance slip away.

notes:
A four-character expression composed of ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧ (one's whole life) and ⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧ (one time). Emphasizes the rarity and irreplaceability of an occasion or opportunity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧: once-in-a-lifetime experience
- {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チャンス→チャンス：03857_chansu⟧: once-in-a-lifetime chance
- {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧: a lifetime memory
- {一生|いっしょう}{一度|いちど}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{買|か}い{物|もの}→買い物：00853_kaimono⟧: a once-in-a-lifetime purchase

CULTURAL NOTE:
Closely related to the tea ceremony concept of ⟦{一期一会|いちごいちえ}→一期一会：04768_ichigoichie⟧ (one time, one meeting), which teaches that every encounter should be treasured as if it may never happen again.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{一期一会|いちごいちえ}→一期一会：04768_ichigoichie⟧: treasure every encounter — philosophical concept from tea ceremony
- ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧: once in a lifetime — the particle-connected variant with identical meaning
- ⟦{滅多|めった}→滅多：13361_metta⟧にない: rare, seldom — describes rarity but without the lifetime emphasis
